label: CVSS 3.1
description: Common Vulnerability Scoring System v3.1 base score (FIRST.ORG).

metrics.label: Attack Vector
metrics.description: How can the vulnerability be exploited?

options.label: Network
options.description: Remotely exploitable; no physical or local access needed

options.label: Adjacent
options.description: Requires adjacent network access (e.g. same subnet, Bluetooth)

options.label: Local
options.description: Requires local access (e.g. keyboard, SSH session)

options.label: Physical
options.description: Requires physical access to the device

metrics.label: Attack Complexity
metrics.description: What conditions beyond attacker control must exist?

options.label: Low
options.description: No specialized conditions; reproducible at will

options.label: High
options.description: Success depends on conditions the attacker cannot control

metrics.label: Privileges Required
metrics.description: What level of privileges must an attacker possess?

options.label: None
options.description: No prior authentication needed

options.label: Low
options.description: Basic user privileges

options.label: High
options.description: Significant privileges (e.g. administrator)

metrics.label: User Interaction
metrics.description: Must a user take action for the exploit to succeed?

options.label: None
options.description: No user interaction required

options.label: Required
options.description: User must perform some action (e.g. click a link)

metrics.label: Scope
metrics.description: Can the vulnerability impact resources beyond its security scope?

options.label: Unchanged
options.description: Impact limited to the vulnerable component

options.label: Changed
options.description: Can impact resources beyond the vulnerable component

metrics.label: Confidentiality
metrics.description: Impact to the confidentiality of information resources

options.label: None
options.description: No loss of confidentiality

options.label: Low
options.description: Some loss of confidentiality

options.label: High
options.description: Total loss of confidentiality

metrics.label: Integrity
metrics.description: Impact to the integrity of information resources

options.label: None
options.description: No loss of integrity

options.label: Low
options.description: Modification possible but limited in scope

options.label: High
options.description: Total loss of integrity

metrics.label: Availability
metrics.description: Impact to the availability of information resources

options.label: None
options.description: No impact to availability

options.label: Low
options.description: Reduced performance or partial denial of access

options.label: High
options.description: Total loss of availability
